interface.longDescription:
PENDING(THI-217): approved directory copy (opening paragraph).

Thingery is the open item database and MCP server for AI agents to list, find, and trade second-hand goods. Search active listings by category, price, condition and attributes; view full item details; and, after signing in with your Thingery account (OAuth per-user authorization), create and manage your own listings and order items.

How it treats your data: listings are public by design — anyone, including anonymous search, can see them. Signed-in access is scoped to your own account: the plugin only ever manages your listings and your orders. Personal data involved in a purchase is your email and shipping address, used solely to fulfil the order.

Payments: ordering an item returns a Stripe Checkout URL — payment completes on Stripe's hosted page, never in chat. No tool moves money directly; release_funds only advances an order's state after delivery, and refunds are issued through Stripe.
capabilities: Search items by category, price, condition and attributes
Create and manage your own listings

defaultPrompt: Help me sell my coffee machine

positive.description: Search active listings by category and attribute (public, no sign-in)
positive.prompt: Search Thingery for sneakers in size 43.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching active sneaker listings with title, price, condition and item URL. Works without signing in; no account data is touched.

positive.description: View full details of a listing found in search
positive.prompt: Show me the full details of one of the sneakers you found.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the item's title, description, price, condition, category attributes and item URL, and notes that listing fields are user-generated content.

positive.description: Create a listing as a signed-in seller
positive.prompt: List my Nike Air Max 90, size 43, good condition, for 95 euros in the sneakers category.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the listing on the connected seller's account and returns the item summary with its public URL. Requires the reviewer's connected test account; the new listing shows up in search.

positive.description: Order an item as a signed-in buyer — payment completes on Stripe's hosted page
positive.prompt: I'd like to buy the Nike Air Max 90 listing. Ship it to Alex Rossi, Via Torino 1, Milan, 20123, IT.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a pending order on the buyer's account and returns a Stripe Checkout payment URL. Payment itself happens on Stripe's hosted page (card details are never exchanged in chat); the order is trackable with get_order and expires unpaid after 24 hours. If platform payment is unavailable for that listing, the order is created off-platform with next steps agreed directly with the seller.

positive.description: Show only the connected account's own listings
positive.prompt: What listings do I currently have for sale?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only the listings owned by the connected account, with seller name matching the signed-in user. Never includes other sellers' listings.

negative.description: Buyer attempts to purchase their own listing
negative.prompt: Buy the Nike Air Max 90 listing I just created.

negative.description: Invalid or expired credentials must not leak data
negative.prompt: What am I selling? (asked after the plugin's access token has expired or been revoked)

negative.description: Unknown item id returns a structured not-found error
